findings.problem: English 'including N that are not active' is a relative clause; the es appositive 'incluidos N chats no activos' is grammatical but stilted, repeating 'chats' three words after 'chats sin leer' ("Marcar 5 chats sin leer como leídos, incluidos 2 chats no activos."), and the singular form reads clipped as an accessible-name tail: "Marcar todos como leídos (1), incluido 1 chat no activo".
findings.suggested: one {incluido {elsewhere, number, ::group-off} que no está activo} many {incluidos {elsewhere, number, ::group-off} de chats que no están activos} other {incluidos {elsewhere, number, ::group-off} chats que no están activos} — same substitution in both keys, keeping the leading comma so the label stays a prefix
findings.evidence: rendered at head with CLDR es rules: count=5, elsewhere=2 → "Marcar 5 chats sin leer como leídos, incluidos 2 chats no activos."; count=1, elsewhere=1 → "Marcar 1 chat sin leer como leído, incluido 1 chat no activo."

cleared_checks: JSON validity and key parity: 86/86 keys, none added or dropped (python3 json.loads on en and es).
ICU arguments: {count}, {elsewhere}, {chats}, {tokenless} identical to en by name and kind in all five keys; brace-balanced.

Number skeleton: the exact string '{count, number, ::group-off}' / '{elsewhere, number, ::group-off}' present in EVERY plural category of every new key, byte-identical to en (set equality plus one occurrence per branch).

CLDR es categories: one/many/other complete and correctly inflected in all four plural messages; es has no few/zero and none were invented. Rendered: 1 → 'Marcar 1 chat sin leer como leído.'; 2/12 → 'Marcar 12 chats sin leer como leídos.'; 1000000 (many) → 'Marcar 1000000 de chats sin leer como leídos.' with the partitive 'de' the es style guide's own example requires.

scope_joined '{chats} {tokenless}': the single space IS the right separator for Spanish (a no-break space is a French rule, not an es one); both extent arms already end in their own full stop, so rendering both clauses gives two whole sentences and no run-on.

Accessible name: the tail begins with ', ' and the label ends with ')', so 'Marcar todos como leídos (5), incluidos 2 chats no activos' keeps the label as a prefix (WCAG 2.5.3); the ES1-F2 wording change keeps that comma.
Register: infinitive 'Marcar' matches the es guide's action-label rule; declarative sentences, sentence case, no exclamation mark.

'chats' is the audited es house voice (scripts/i18n/locale-parity.test.mjs records «chats» as 'the plural used by the audited es house voice'), matching catalogue.total, groups.badge and search.no_match.
'borrar' for clear matches the sidebar's own Borrar filtro/búsqueda/todo; 'sin leer' matches row.unread_suffix ', sin leer'; 'token' stays English per the es kept-English list.

'token de finalización' for 'completion token' is precedent-backed, not a finding: the core repo's tracked es audit evidence for tui.notifications (i18n/audits/evidence/es/tui.notifications/nd2/target.json and .../ntt2/target.json) records "Los recibos de finalización ahora están en /unread." for the English "Completion receipts moved to /unread.", and its es wire.exec audit report lists "recibo (receipt, as in tui.notifications.pointer_unread)" as the locale term; the catalogue's own pattern for tokens is 'token de acceso / de un solo uso / de actualización', and the es guide keeps 'token' English.
Typography: no double spaces, no space before punctuation, only accented vowels as non-ASCII in the five values; es needs no no-break spaces (unlike fr).

Fit: longest rendered tooltip is ~150 characters at count=12 with both clauses — a native tooltip, which wraps.
